    FOREIGN KEY (package_id, package_version, package_sha256)
        REFERENCES packages(package_id, version, sha256),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id, package_id, package_version, package_sha256)
        REFERENCES campaign_package_memberships(campaign_id, package_id, version, sha256)
)

CREATE TABLE agent_session_messages (
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (sequence > 0),
    message_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN (
        'user', 'safe_think', 'talk', 'steering', 'evidence',
        'canonical_reference', 'human_review'
    )),
    content_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    canonical_sequence INTEGER,
    PRIMARY KEY (session_id, sequence),
    UNIQUE (session_id, message_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions(session_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CHECK (
        (kind = 'canonical_reference' AND canonical_sequence IS NOT NULL)
        OR (kind != 'canonical_reference' AND canonical_sequence IS NULL)
    )
)

CREATE TABLE agent_sessions (
    session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('builder', 'dm')),
    provider_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    model_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN (
        'active', 'stopped', 'completed', 'review_required', 'handoff_closed'
    )),
    parent_session_id TEXT,
    selected_skill TEXT CHECK (selected_skill IN (
        'BUILD RULESET', 'BUILD CAMPAIGN SETTING', 'BUILD CAMPAIGN PLAN'
    )),
    scope_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (parent_session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions(session_id),
    CHECK (
        (role = 'builder' AND selected_skill IS NOT NULL)
        OR (role = 'dm' AND selected_skill IS NULL)
    )
)

CREATE TABLE authority_schema_extensions (
    extension_name TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    extension_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    predecessor_migration_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    predecessor_sql_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE builder_dm_handoffs (
    handoff_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    builder_session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    dm_session_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    package_lock_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    package_candidate_id TEXT,
    plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    plan_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (plan_revision > 0),
    plan_content_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    expected_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (expected_revision >= 0),
    resulting_campaign_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
        resulting_campaign_revision = expected_revision + 1
    ),
    chronology_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (chronology_ordinal = 1),
    completed_turn_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    safe_payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (builder_session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions(session_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (dm_session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions(session_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (package_lock_id) REFERENCES campaign_locks(lock_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (package_candidate_id) REFERENCES package_candidates(candidate_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (plan_id) REFERENCES campaign_plans(plan_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id, completed_turn_id) REFERENCES turns(campaign_id, turn_id)
)

CREATE TABLE campaign_constructions (
    campaign_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    confirmation_operation_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    authority_turn_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    authority_lock_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    confirmation_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (confirmation_revision = 0),
    lane TEXT CHECK (lane IN ('quick_start', 'customize')),
    canonical_input_json TEXT,
    begin_operation_id TEXT UNIQUE,
    begin_revision INTEGER CHECK (begin_revision > 0),
    canonical_plan_json TEXT,
    completion_operation_id TEXT UNIQUE,
    completion_revision INTEGER CHECK (completion_revision > 0),
    canonical_representation_sha256 TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (confirmation_operation_id) REFERENCES campaign_operations(operation_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (begin_operation_id) REFERENCES campaign_operations(operation_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (completion_operation_id) REFERENCES campaign_operations(operation_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id, authority_turn_id) REFERENCES turns(campaign_id, turn_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (authority_lock_id) REFERENCES campaign_locks(lock_id),
    CHECK (
        (lane IS NULL AND canonical_input_json IS NULL AND begin_operation_id IS NULL
            AND begin_revision IS NULL AND canonical_plan_json IS NULL
            AND completion_operation_id IS NULL AND completion_revision IS NULL
            AND canonical_representation_sha256 IS NULL)
        OR
        (lane IS NOT NULL AND canonical_input_json IS NOT NULL AND begin_operation_id IS NOT NULL
            AND begin_revision IS NOT NULL AND canonical_plan_json IS NULL
            AND completion_operation_id IS NULL AND completion_revision IS NULL
            AND canonical_representation_sha256 IS NULL)
        OR
        (lane IS NOT NULL AND canonical_input_json IS NOT NULL AND begin_operation_id IS NOT NULL
            AND begin_revision IS NOT NULL AND canonical_plan_json IS NOT NULL
            AND completion_operation_id IS NOT NULL AND completion_revision IS NOT NULL
            AND canonical_representation_sha256 IS NOT NULL)
    )
)

CREATE TABLE campaign_lifecycle_state (
    campaign_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    retained_active_writer TEXT,
    designated_session_id TEXT,
    tombstone_prior_lifecycle TEXT,
    tombstone_prior_writer TEXT,
    tombstone_prior_session_id TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (designated_session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions(session_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (tombstone_prior_session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions(session_id),
    CHECK (retained_active_writer IS NULL OR retained_active_writer IN ('builder', 'dm')),
    CHECK (
        tombstone_prior_lifecycle IS NULL
        OR tombstone_prior_lifecycle IN ('active', 'archived')
    ),
    CHECK (tombstone_prior_writer IS NULL OR tombstone_prior_writer IN ('none', 'builder', 'dm'))
)

CREATE TABLE campaign_lifecycle_transitions (
    operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    operation_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    basis_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
    resulting_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
    from_lifecycle TEXT NOT NULL,
    to_lifecycle TEXT NOT NULL,
    from_writer TEXT NOT NULL,
    to_writer TEXT NOT NULL,
    designated_session_id TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (operation_id) REFERENCES campaign_operations(operation_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (designated_session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions(session_id),
    UNIQUE (campaign_id, resulting_revision),
    CHECK (
        operation_kind IN (
            'rename_campaign', 'archive_campaign', 'restore_campaign', 'trash_campaign'
        )
    ),
    CHECK (resulting_revision = basis_revision + 1),
    CHECK (from_lifecycle IN ('active', 'archived', 'tombstoned')),
    CHECK (to_lifecycle IN ('active', 'archived', 'tombstoned')),
    CHECK (from_writer IN ('none', 'builder', 'dm')),
    CHECK (to_writer IN ('none', 'builder', 'dm'))
)

CREATE TABLE campaign_lock_memberships (
    lock_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    closure_order INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (closure_order >= 0),
    package_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    version TEXT NOT NULL,
    content_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('primary', 'dependency')),
    PRIMARY KEY (lock_id, closure_order),
    UNIQUE (lock_id, package_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (lock_id) REFERENCES campaign_locks(lock_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (package_id, version, content_sha256)
        REFERENCES packages(package_id, version, sha256)
)

CREATE TABLE campaign_locks (
    lock_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    closure_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    availability TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (availability IN ('available', 'legacy_unavailable')),
    predecessor_lock_id TEXT,
    created_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_revision >= 0),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (predecessor_lock_id) REFERENCES campaign_locks(lock_id)
)

CREATE TABLE campaign_operations (
    operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    operation_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    semantic_payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    semantic_payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    result_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    basis_turn_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    basis_lock_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    basis_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (basis_revision >= 0),
    resulting_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (resulting_revision >= 0),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id, basis_turn_id) REFERENCES turns(campaign_id, turn_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (basis_lock_id) REFERENCES campaign_locks(lock_id)
)

CREATE TABLE campaign_package_memberships (
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    package_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    version TEXT NOT NULL,
    sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('primary', 'dependency')),
    load_order INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (load_order >= 0),
    PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, package_id, version, sha256),
    UNIQUE (campaign_id, load_order),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (package_id, version, sha256)
        REFERENCES packages(package_id, version, sha256)
)

CREATE TABLE campaign_plans (
    plan_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    package_lock_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    content_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    content_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    provenance_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    validation_outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (validation_outcome = 'valid'),
    acceptance_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (acceptance_status = 'accepted'),
    plan_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (plan_revision > 0),
    resulting_campaign_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (resulting_campaign_revision > 0),
    payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (campaign_id, plan_revision),
    UNIQUE (campaign_id, resulting_campaign_revision),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (package_lock_id) REFERENCES campaign_locks(lock_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (source_session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions(session_id)
)

CREATE TABLE campaign_recovery_receipts (
    recovery_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    semantic_payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    semantic_payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    archive_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    archive_byte_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (archive_byte_count >= 0),
    captured_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (captured_revision >= 0),
    result_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id)
)

CREATE TABLE campaign_revisions (
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
    action_id TEXT, activation_id TEXT, plan_id TEXT, handoff_id TEXT, construction_operation_id TEXT, lifecycle_operation_id TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, revision),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id, action_id) REFERENCES actions(campaign_id, action_id)
)

CREATE TABLE campaign_state (
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    namespace TEXT NOT NULL,
    state_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    value_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, namespace, state_key),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE campaign_state_namespace_owners (
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    namespace TEXT NOT NULL,
    owner_package_id TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, namespace),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE campaigns (
    campaign_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    lifecycle TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (lifecycle IN ('active', 'archived', 'tombstoned')),
    writer TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (writer IN ('builder', 'dm', 'none')),
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision >= 0),
    lock_hash TEXT NOT NULL
, current_lock_id TEXT)

CREATE TABLE canonical_events (
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
    event_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (event_type IN (
        'think', 'talk', 'action_declared', 'tool_call', 'tool_result',
        'state_mutation', 'consequence', 'action_committed', 'action_failed'
    )),
    turn_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_id TEXT,
    safe_payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    visibility TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (visibility IN ('internal_safe', 'player_safe')),
    attempt_id TEXT,
    attempt_ordinal INTEGER,
    PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, sequence),
    UNIQUE (campaign_id, attempt_id, attempt_ordinal),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id, action_id) REFERENCES actions(campaign_id, action_id),
    CHECK (
        (
            event_type IN ('think', 'talk')
            AND action_id IS NULL
            AND visibility = 'player_safe'
            AND attempt_id IS NOT NULL
            AND attempt_ordinal IS NOT NULL
            AND attempt_ordinal >= 0
        ) OR (
            event_type NOT IN ('think', 'talk')
            AND action_id IS NOT NULL
            AND attempt_id IS NULL
            AND attempt_ordinal IS NULL
            AND (
                (event_type IN ('tool_call', 'tool_result') AND visibility = 'player_safe')
                OR
                (event_type NOT IN ('tool_call', 'tool_result')
                    AND visibility = 'internal_safe')
            )
        )
    )
)

CREATE TABLE consequences (
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,
    payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, action_id, ordinal),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id, action_id) REFERENCES actions(campaign_id, action_id)
)

CREATE TABLE idempotency_records (
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    result_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    resulting_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, idempotency_key),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id, action_id) REFERENCES actions(campaign_id, action_id)
)

CREATE TABLE mechanics_choice_resolutions (
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    resolution_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    choice_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    option_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    resolution_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    descriptor_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    session_id TEXT,
    resulting_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (resulting_revision >= 1),
    PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, resolution_id),
    UNIQUE (campaign_id, action_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id, action_id) REFERENCES actions(campaign_id, action_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions(session_id)
)

CREATE TABLE mutations (
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,
    namespace TEXT NOT NULL,
    state_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    before_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    after_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, action_id, ordinal),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id, action_id) REFERENCES actions(campaign_id, action_id)
)

CREATE TABLE narration_interruptions (
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    interruption_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    turn_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_action_id TEXT,
    failed_attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('retryable', 'resolved')),
    resolving_retry_id TEXT,
    resolved_sequence INTEGER,
    PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, interruption_id),
    UNIQUE (campaign_id, failed_attempt_id),
    UNIQUE (campaign_id, resolving_retry_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id, turn_id) REFERENCES turns(campaign_id, turn_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id, last_action_id) REFERENCES actions(campaign_id, action_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id, resolved_sequence)
        REFERENCES canonical_events(campaign_id, sequence),
    CHECK (
        (status = 'retryable' AND resolved_sequence IS NULL)
        OR
        (status = 'resolved' AND resolving_retry_id IS NOT NULL
            AND resolved_sequence IS NOT NULL)
    )
)

CREATE TABLE package_activations (
    activation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    old_lock_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    new_lock_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    migration_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('committed', 'failed')),
    resulting_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
    result_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (candidate_id) REFERENCES package_candidates(candidate_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (old_lock_id) REFERENCES campaign_locks(lock_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (new_lock_id) REFERENCES campaign_locks(lock_id)
)

CREATE TABLE package_blob_chunks (
    blob_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    chunk_order INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (chunk_order >= 0),
    byte_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (byte_count >= 0),
    chunk_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    data BLOB NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (blob_sha256, chunk_order),
    FOREIGN KEY (blob_sha256) REFERENCES package_blobs(blob_sha256) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE package_blobs (
    blob_sha256 TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    byte_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (byte_count >= 0),
    chunk_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (chunk_count >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE package_candidate_memberships (
    candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    closure_order INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (closure_order >= 0),
    package_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    version TEXT NOT NULL,
    content_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (candidate_id, closure_order),
    UNIQUE (candidate_id, package_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (candidate_id) REFERENCES package_candidates(candidate_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (package_id, version, content_sha256)
        REFERENCES package_manifests(package_id, version, content_sha256)
)

CREATE TABLE package_candidates (
    candidate_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    install_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('validated', 'activated', 'failed')),
    closure_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    report_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (install_id) REFERENCES package_staging(install_id)
)

CREATE TABLE package_capabilities (
    package_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    version TEXT NOT NULL,
    content_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    capability_order INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (capability_order >= 0),
    capability TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (package_id, version, content_sha256, capability_order),
    UNIQUE (package_id, version, content_sha256, capability),
    FOREIGN KEY (package_id, version, content_sha256)
        REFERENCES package_manifests(package_id, version, content_sha256) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE package_dependencies (
    package_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    version TEXT NOT NULL,
    sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    dependency_order INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (dependency_order >= 0),
    dependency_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    dependency_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    dependency_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    dependency_kind TEXT NOT NULL, dependency_namespace TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'legacy',
    PRIMARY KEY (package_id, version, sha256, dependency_order),
    UNIQUE (package_id, version, sha256, dependency_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (package_id, version, sha256)
        REFERENCES packages(package_id, version, sha256),
    FOREIGN KEY (dependency_id, dependency_version, dependency_sha256)
        REFERENCES packages(package_id, version, sha256)
)

CREATE TABLE package_exact_dependencies (
    package_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    version TEXT NOT NULL,
    content_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    dependency_order INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (dependency_order >= 0),
    dependency_namespace TEXT NOT NULL,
    dependency_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    dependency_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    dependency_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    dependency_content_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (package_id, version, content_sha256, dependency_order),
    UNIQUE (package_id, version, content_sha256, dependency_namespace),
    FOREIGN KEY (package_id, version, content_sha256)
        REFERENCES package_manifests(package_id, version, content_sha256) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (dependency_id, dependency_version, dependency_content_sha256)
        REFERENCES package_manifests(package_id, version, content_sha256)
)

CREATE TABLE package_manifest_files (
    package_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    version TEXT NOT NULL,
    content_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    file_order INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (file_order >= 0),
    portable_path TEXT NOT NULL,
    byte_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (byte_count >= 0),
    blob_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (package_id, version, content_sha256, file_order),
    UNIQUE (package_id, version, content_sha256, portable_path),
    FOREIGN KEY (package_id, version, content_sha256)
        REFERENCES package_manifests(package_id, version, content_sha256) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (blob_sha256) REFERENCES package_blobs(blob_sha256)
)

CREATE TABLE package_manifests (
    package_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    version TEXT NOT NULL,
    content_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('primary', 'dependency')),
    canonical_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    provenance_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    compatibility_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('published', 'reclaimed')),
    PRIMARY KEY (package_id, version, content_sha256),
    FOREIGN KEY (package_id, version, content_sha256)
        REFERENCES packages(package_id, version, sha256)
)

CREATE TABLE package_participant_artifacts (

    version TEXT NOT NULL,
    content_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    artifact_order INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (artifact_order >= 0),
    kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    schema_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    schema_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    schema_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (package_id, version, content_sha256, artifact_order),
    UNIQUE (package_id, version, content_sha256, kind),
    FOREIGN KEY (package_id, version, content_sha256)
        REFERENCES package_manifests(package_id, version, content_sha256) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE package_prompt_fragments (
    package_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    version TEXT NOT NULL,
    content_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    surface_order INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (surface_order >= 0),
    fragment_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    capability TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (package_id, version, content_sha256, surface_order),
    UNIQUE (package_id, version, content_sha256, fragment_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (package_id, version, content_sha256)
        REFERENCES package_manifests(package_id, version, content_sha256) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE package_read_leases (
    lease_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    blob_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,

)

CREATE TABLE package_recovery_roots (

    FOREIGN KEY (blob_sha256) REFERENCES package_blobs(blob_sha256)
)

CREATE TABLE package_staging (

    report_json TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE package_staging_chunks (
    install_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    file_order INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (file_order >= 0),
    chunk_order INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (chunk_order >= 0),
    package_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    version TEXT NOT NULL,
    content_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,

    PRIMARY KEY (install_id, file_order, chunk_order),

CREATE TABLE package_tools (

    content_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,

    capability TEXT NOT NULL,
    input_schema_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    state_predicates_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    turn_statuses_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    writers_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (package_id, version, content_sha256, tool_order),
    UNIQUE (package_id, version, content_sha256, tool_name),
    FOREIGN KEY (package_id, version, content_sha256)
        REFERENCES package_manifests(package_id, version, content_sha256) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE package_ui_surfaces (
    package_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    version TEXT NOT NULL,
    content_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    surface_order INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (surface_order >= 0),
    surface_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    capability TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (package_id, version, content_sha256, surface_order),
    UNIQUE (package_id, version, content_sha256, surface_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (package_id, version, content_sha256)
        REFERENCES package_manifests(package_id, version, content_sha256) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE packages (
    package_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    version TEXT NOT NULL,
    sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    capabilities_json TEXT NOT NULL,

CREATE TRIGGER campaign_state_owner_delete_requires_empty
BEFORE DELETE ON campaign_state_namespace_owners
WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM campaign_state AS state
    WHERE state.campaign_id = OLD.campaign_id
      AND state.namespace = OLD.namespace
)
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'campaign state namespace owner still has state');
END

CREATE TRIGGER campaign_state_owner_immutable
BEFORE UPDATE ON campaign_state_namespace_owners
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'campaign state namespace owner is immutable');
END

CREATE TRIGGER campaign_state_owner_matches_current_lock
BEFORE INSERT ON campaign_state_namespace_owners
BEGIN
    SELECT CASE WHEN
        (
            NEW.owner_package_id IS NULL
            AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM campaigns AS campaign
                JOIN campaign_lock_memberships AS membership
                  ON membership.lock_id = campaign.current_lock_id
                WHERE campaign.campaign_id = NEW.campaign_id
            )
        )
        OR (
            NEW.owner_package_id IS NOT NULL
            AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM campaigns AS campaign
                JOIN campaign_lock_memberships AS membership
                  ON membership.lock_id = campaign.current_lock_id
                WHERE campaign.campaign_id = NEW.campaign_id
                  AND membership.package_id = NEW.owner_package_id
            )
        )
        OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM campaigns AS campaign
            JOIN campaign_lock_memberships AS membership
              ON membership.lock_id = campaign.current_lock_id
            WHERE campaign.campaign_id = NEW.campaign_id
              AND NEW.namespace LIKE membership.package_id || '.%'
              AND membership.package_id <> NEW.owner_package_id
        )
        THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'campaign state namespace owner conflicts with current lock')
    END;
END

CREATE TRIGGER campaign_state_owner_required_insert
BEFORE INSERT ON campaign_state
BEGIN
    SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM campaign_state_namespace_owners AS owner
        WHERE owner.campaign_id = NEW.campaign_id
          AND owner.namespace = NEW.namespace
    ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'campaign state namespace owner is required') END;
END

CREATE TRIGGER campaign_state_owner_required_update
BEFORE UPDATE OF campaign_id, namespace ON campaign_state
BEGIN
    SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM campaign_state_namespace_owners AS owner
        WHERE owner.campaign_id = NEW.campaign_id
          AND owner.namespace = NEW.namespace
    ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'campaign state namespace owner is required') END;
END

CREATE TRIGGER mutation_requires_matching_namespace_owner
BEFORE INSERT ON mutations
BEGIN
    SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM actions AS action
        JOIN campaign_state_namespace_owners AS owner
          ON owner.campaign_id = NEW.campaign_id
         AND owner.namespace = NEW.namespace
        WHERE action.campaign_id = NEW.campaign_id
          AND action.action_id = NEW.action_id
          AND owner.owner_package_id IS NOT NULL
          AND owner.owner_package_id = action.package_id
    ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'mutation package does not own state namespace') END;
END

        REFERENCES packages(package_id, version, sha256),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id, package_id, package_version, package_sha256)
        REFERENCES campaign_package_memberships(campaign_id, package_id, version, sha256)

CREATE TABLE agent_session_messages (
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (sequence > 0),
    message_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN (
        'user', 'safe_think', 'talk', 'steering', 'evidence',
        'canonical_reference', 'human_review'
    )),
    content_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    canonical_sequence INTEGER,
    PRIMARY KEY (session_id, sequence),
    UNIQUE (session_id, message_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions(session_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CHECK (
        (kind = 'canonical_reference' AND canonical_sequence IS NOT NULL)
        OR (kind != 'canonical_reference' AND canonical_sequence IS NULL)
    )
)

CREATE TABLE agent_sessions (
    session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('builder', 'dm')),
    provider_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    model_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN (
        'active', 'stopped', 'completed', 'review_required', 'handoff_closed'
    )),
    parent_session_id TEXT,
    selected_skill TEXT CHECK (selected_skill IN (
        'BUILD RULESET', 'BUILD CAMPAIGN SETTING', 'BUILD CAMPAIGN PLAN'
    )),
    scope_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (parent_session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions(session_id),
    CHECK (
        (role = 'builder' AND selected_skill IS NOT NULL)
        OR (role = 'dm' AND selected_skill IS NULL)
    )
)

CREATE TABLE builder_dm_handoffs (
    handoff_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    builder_session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    dm_session_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    package_lock_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    package_candidate_id TEXT,
    plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    plan_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (plan_revision > 0),
    plan_content_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    expected_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (expected_revision >= 0),
    resulting_campaign_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (
        resulting_campaign_revision = expected_revision + 1
    ),
    chronology_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (chronology_ordinal = 1),
    completed_turn_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    safe_payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

)

CREATE TABLE campaign_lock_memberships (
    lock_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    closure_order INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (closure_order >= 0),
    package_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    version TEXT NOT NULL,
    content_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('primary', 'dependency')),
    PRIMARY KEY (lock_id, closure_order),
    UNIQUE (lock_id, package_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (lock_id) REFERENCES campaign_locks(lock_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (package_id, version, content_sha256)
        REFERENCES packages(package_id, version, sha256)
)

CREATE TABLE campaign_locks (
    lock_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    closure_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    availability TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (availability IN ('available', 'legacy_unavailable')),
    predecessor_lock_id TEXT,

    FOREIGN KEY (predecessor_lock_id) REFERENCES campaign_locks(lock_id)

CREATE TABLE campaign_package_memberships (
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,

    version TEXT NOT NULL,

    role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('primary', 'dependency')),
    load_order INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (load_order >= 0),

CREATE TABLE campaign_plans (

    content_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    provenance_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    validation_outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (validation_outcome = 'valid'),
    acceptance_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (acceptance_status = 'accepted'),
    plan_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (plan_revision > 0),
    resulting_campaign_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (resulting_campaign_revision > 0),
    payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (campaign_id, plan_revision),
    UNIQUE (campaign_id, resulting_campaign_revision),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (package_lock_id) REFERENCES campaign_locks(lock_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (source_session_id) REFERENCES agent_sessions(session_id)
)

CREATE TABLE campaign_revisions (
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
    action_id TEXT, activation_id TEXT, plan_id TEXT, handoff_id TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, revision),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id, action_id) REFERENCES actions(campaign_id, action_id)
)

CREATE TABLE campaign_state (
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    namespace TEXT NOT NULL,
    state_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    value_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, namespace, state_key),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE campaigns (
    campaign_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    lifecycle TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (lifecycle IN ('active', 'archived', 'tombstoned')),
    writer TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (writer IN ('builder', 'dm', 'none')),
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision >= 0),
    lock_hash TEXT NOT NULL
, current_lock_id TEXT)

CREATE TABLE canonical_events (
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
    event_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (event_type IN (
        'think', 'talk', 'action_declared', 'tool_call', 'tool_result',
        'state_mutation', 'consequence', 'action_committed', 'action_failed'
    )),
    turn_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_id TEXT,
    safe_payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    visibility TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (visibility IN ('internal_safe', 'player_safe')),
    attempt_id TEXT,
    attempt_ordinal INTEGER,
    PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, sequence),
    UNIQUE (campaign_id, attempt_id, attempt_ordinal),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id, action_id) REFERENCES actions(campaign_id, action_id),
    CHECK (
        (
            event_type IN ('think', 'talk')
            AND action_id IS NULL
            AND visibility = 'player_safe'
            AND attempt_id IS NOT NULL
            AND attempt_ordinal IS NOT NULL
            AND attempt_ordinal >= 0
        ) OR (
            event_type NOT IN ('think', 'talk')
            AND action_id IS NOT NULL
            AND attempt_id IS NULL
            AND attempt_ordinal IS NULL
            AND (
                (event_type IN ('tool_call', 'tool_result') AND visibility = 'player_safe')
                OR
                (event_type NOT IN ('tool_call', 'tool_result')
                    AND visibility = 'internal_safe')
            )
        )
    )
)

CREATE TABLE consequences (
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,
    payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, action_id, ordinal),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id, action_id) REFERENCES actions(campaign_id, action_id)
)

CREATE TABLE idempotency_records (
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    result_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    resulting_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, idempotency_key),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id, action_id) REFERENCES actions(campaign_id, action_id)
)

CREATE TABLE mutations (
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,
    namespace TEXT NOT NULL,
    state_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    before_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    after_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, action_id, ordinal),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id, action_id) REFERENCES actions(campaign_id, action_id)
)

CREATE TABLE narration_interruptions (
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    interruption_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    turn_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_action_id TEXT,
    failed_attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('retryable', 'resolved')),
    resolving_retry_id TEXT,
    resolved_sequence INTEGER,
    PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, interruption_id),
    UNIQUE (campaign_id, failed_attempt_id),
    UNIQUE (campaign_id, resolving_retry_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id, turn_id) REFERENCES turns(campaign_id, turn_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id, last_action_id) REFERENCES actions(campaign_id, action_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id, resolved_sequence)
        REFERENCES canonical_events(campaign_id, sequence),
    CHECK (
        (status = 'retryable' AND resolved_sequence IS NULL)
        OR
        (status = 'resolved' AND resolving_retry_id IS NOT NULL
            AND resolved_sequence IS NOT NULL)
    )
)

CREATE TABLE package_activations (

    result_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (candidate_id) REFERENCES package_candidates(candidate_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (old_lock_id) REFERENCES campaign_locks(lock_id),

)

CREATE TABLE package_blob_chunks (

CREATE TABLE package_blobs (

CREATE TABLE package_candidate_memberships (

CREATE TABLE package_candidates (

CREATE TABLE package_capabilities (

)

    UNIQUE (package_id, version, sha256, dependency_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (package_id, version, sha256)
        REFERENCES packages(package_id, version, sha256),
    FOREIGN KEY (dependency_id, dependency_version, dependency_sha256)
        REFERENCES packages(package_id, version, sha256)
)

CREATE TABLE package_exact_dependencies (

    version TEXT NOT NULL,
    content_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,

    dependency_namespace TEXT NOT NULL,
    dependency_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    dependency_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    dependency_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    dependency_content_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (package_id, version, content_sha256, dependency_order),
    UNIQUE (package_id, version, content_sha256, dependency_namespace),
    FOREIGN KEY (package_id, version, content_sha256)

CREATE TABLE package_manifest_files (

)

CREATE TABLE package_read_leases (

CREATE TABLE package_recovery_roots (

)

CREATE TABLE package_staging (

CREATE TABLE package_staging_chunks (
    install_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    file_order INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (file_order >= 0),
    chunk_order INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (chunk_order >= 0),
    package_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    version TEXT NOT NULL,
    content_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    portable_path TEXT NOT NULL,
    chunk_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    data BLOB NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (install_id, file_order, chunk_order),
    FOREIGN KEY (install_id) REFERENCES package_staging(install_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE package_tools (
    package_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    version TEXT NOT NULL,
    content_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    tool_order INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (tool_order >= 0),
    tool_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    capability TEXT NOT NULL,
    input_schema_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    state_predicates_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    turn_statuses_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    writers_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (package_id, version, content_sha256, tool_order),
    UNIQUE (package_id, version, content_sha256, tool_name),
    FOREIGN KEY (package_id, version, content_sha256)
        REFERENCES package_manifests(package_id, version, content_sha256) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE package_ui_surfaces (
    package_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    version TEXT NOT NULL,
    content_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    surface_order INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (surface_order >= 0),
    surface_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    capability TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (package_id, version, content_sha256, surface_order),
    UNIQUE (package_id, version, content_sha256, surface_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (package_id, version, content_sha256)
        REFERENCES package_manifests(package_id, version, content_sha256) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE packages (
    package_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    version TEXT NOT NULL,
    sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    capabilities_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (package_id, version, sha256)
)

CREATE TABLE participants (
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    participant_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    package_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    package_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    data_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, participant_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE schema_migrations (
    version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    applied_name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    sql_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE turns (
    campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    turn_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('open', 'completed')),
    created_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, turn_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns(campaign_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
